question: Who won the Album of the Year at the 67th Annual Grammy Awards in 2025?

options.text: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Beyoncé - Cowboy Carter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beyoncé** is a globally renowned American singer, songwriter, and actress known for her exceptional contributions to music and culture.
 
• The album "**Cowboy Carter**" won the **Album of the Year** at the **67th Annual Grammy Awards in 2025**, showcasing Beyoncé's ability to innovate and redefine music genres.
 
• Her music often incorporates elements of **pop, R&B, soul, and hip-hop**, making her one of the most versatile artists of her time.
 
• The album "**Cowboy Carter**" was praised for its **unique themes**, production quality, and Beyoncé's powerful vocal performances.
 
• Beyoncé has won numerous **Grammy Awards** over her career, solidifying her status as one of the most awarded artists in Grammy history.
 
• Her artistic influence extends beyond music, as she is also recognized for her contributions to **fashion, philanthropy, and activism**.
 
• The 67th Annual Grammy Awards in 2025 further underscored her enduring relevance and dominance in the music industry.

• **Taylor Swift - The Tortured Poets Department**__

 __
 
• **Taylor Swift** is an American singer-songwriter known for her narrative songwriting and exploration of various musical styles.
 
• The album "**The Tortured Poets Department**" demonstrates her lyrical prowess, but it did not win the Album of the Year at the 67th Annual Grammy Awards.
 
 
 
• **Sabrina Carpenter - Short n' Sweet**__
 __
 
• **Sabrina Carpenter** is a pop artist known for her upbeat and youthful music.
 
• The album "**Short n' Sweet**" gained popularity among her fans but was not awarded Album of the Year in 2025.
 
 
 
• **Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft**__
 
 
• **Billie Eilish** is a celebrated artist known for her dark, moody sound and unique approach to music.
 
• While the album "**Hit Me Hard and Soft**" was well-received, it did not win the Album of the Year award.
